comment: Human-judged FALSE POSITIVES from the photo identity audit — cases a person checked against Commons metadata / Foursquare and confirmed the photo is right. Each entry hides exactly one (slug, key) pair from the report. key = the Commons file title (🟡 nearby bucket) or the FULL Foursquare credit line (🏷️ wrong-venue bucket). A new photo on the same slug has a new title/credit and reports again; never add an entry for a photo nobody has looked at. Contradictions and stock cannot be allowlisted here by design — fix the rule, not the instance.

judged.note: looked at the photo: the park's fountain pond with the Eiffel-tower replica behind it — Central Park itself. Azara is a restaurant inside the park, which is the page the photo was uploaded to.

judged.key: Photo: Foursquare user content (Al Seef Old Dubai)
judged.note: same place under two names: the guide describes the recreated heritage village on the Bur Dubai creekside at Al Hamriya, which is Al Seef. The hero is a Commons photo of the same stretch.
